cases.name: etaf-devtools-open-renders-target-and-excludes-self
cases.purpose: Opening `etaf-devtools' attaches to a mounted ETAF target, renders Component/Host tree, Box Model and ECSS provenance, and excludes DevTools' own Runtime from target discovery.

cases.name: etaf-devtools-tabs-and-responsive-viewports-render-cleanly
cases.purpose: All six panels (Tree, Styles, State, Perf, Keys, Runtime) render across wide, medium and narrow viewports via documented keyboard navigation.

cases.name: etaf-devtools-highlight-updates-is-zero-distortion-and-cleans-up
cases.purpose: Highlight Updates flashes changed lines via read-only overlays without advancing target Runtime revision or mutating buffer text, and cleans up every overlay on disable or close.

cases.name: etaf-devtools-live-ref-edit-and-viewport-qa-drive-target
cases.purpose: Live State editing updates a target Component's writable `etaf-ref' in place, and Runtime QA viewport presets refit the target Runtime cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-devtools-headless-session-survives-target-unmount-and-doctor
cases.purpose: Headless `etaf-devtools-create'/`etaf-devtools-view'/`etaf-devtools-dispose' handles target unmount cleanly, and `etaf-devtools-doctor' reports required and optional capabilities.
